summary: Very steep short dead-end kerb, with houses 6-11 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Treed, but a house 6 m away at the south end and others 10-17 m from the north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed dead end onto the main road; no flat ground wide enough beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead end close to a busy main road.
drivers.convention: No signs; a few cars park at the end, no van convention.

flags: Steep: mean 17%, max 26%, well over the 12% limit
Noise from the main road at the south end
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of the stretch, open at the bottom junction.
